user.title: Connect your ALSO account
user.description: Enter the e-mail address of your ALSO account. A one-time code will be sent to it.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.description: Enter the one-time code that was sent to {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your ALSO session has expired. Submit to send a new one-time code to {email}.

reauth_otp.title: Enter the code
reauth_otp.description: Enter the one-time code that was sent to {email}.

error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest e-mail and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ALSO service. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This ALSO account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The code belongs to a different ALSO account than this entry.

init.title: ALSO options
init.description: Live updates arrive over a push connection. The poll only refreshes values the connection does not carry, so a slow interval is fine.
